newsitem.title: USA: Banc One to put ATMs in Mail Boxes Etc.
newsitem.headline: Banc One to put ATMs in Mail Boxes Etc.

text.p: Banc One Corp plans to install 2,000 automated teller machines in Mail Boxes Etc stores nationwide, the companies said Tuesday.

Terms were not disclosed. Mail Boxes Etc's nearly 2,700 U.S. stores, called MBE Centers, offer packing, shipping, photocopying, faxing and other services. It said in a joint statement it is the world's largest franchisor of such centers, with an additional 600 outside the U.S.
In an ancillary pilot program at selected locations the companies said they will offer automated loan machines, financial services via interactive video and other services.
Modified MBE Centers will be established in selected existing Banc One branches as part of the same pilot.
Automated teller machines, where customers can get cash or perform other banking transactions, could also sell prepaid phone cards, postage stamps, they said.
The first thousand units are expected to be in place by yearend, the companies said.
"We are very interested in expanding our business banking presence throughout the country," Kenneth Stevens, chairman and chief executive officer of Banc One's Retail Group, said in the statement.

"This convergence of postal, business and communications services with financial services reflects the importance of the small-office and home-office markets to both Banc One and MBE," he said. "MBE Centers attract many small business customers that make them a perfect fit for us."
Banc One, based in Columbus, has more than 1,500 offices nationwide and $101.8 billion in assets. Mail Boxes Etc is based in San Diego.
